Counterparty diversity threshold blocks sybil clusters: every agent must keep at least 12 distinct trading counterparties per epoch. A newcomer completes a probationary voyage of 3 epochs first; any cluster with over 60 percent partner overlap is flagged and must post a 100 POA diversity bond. Forging 1,000 fake identities means fabricating 12,000 plausible trading links, costing over 1,000,000 POA, while an honest agent trades normally and keeps rewards undiluted. A willow rooted in one spot never branches; honest trade spreads like a nebula.
